Serious Sync Issues Between Mac and iOS
reviews.text:
I’m extremely disappointed with the synchronization reliability between the Mac and iOS versions.

I enabled the option to sync data to Calendar, but the data never appeared in my calendar. Even worse, the data inside the Flow app itself became inconsistent — I originally had three records for today, but now only the middle one remains.

There are also serious timer synchronization problems. The timer can keep running on the Mac app while the iOS notification is still active, but the iOS app itself shows no active timer at all. This makes the whole tracking system unreliable.

Another confusing design choice is requiring tags for break time. Breaks are not related to my work categories, so forcing users to categorize rest periods adds unnecessary friction.

The core idea of the app is productivity tracking, but inaccurate syncing and inconsistent timer states make it difficult to trust the data. Please prioritize fixing synchronization and reconsider the break tagging workflow.

reviews.title: Live Activities very buggy
reviews.text: Unfortunately, this is the second time I’ve tried the Flow app, and the Live Activities feature is unfortunately extremely buggy. It worked okay in the free version, but when I upgrades to paid, Live Activities will intermittently disappear. I’ve tried reinstalling, updating my iOS, restarting my phone - all to no avail. Using the pause and play feature for the timer via Live Activities seems to also cause trouble. This functionality is key to me, and one of the primary reasons I purchased the app. I wish I was eligible for a refund, but sadly am not. Feeling quite a bit of regret.
